post.description:
Build feedback from owned backend evidence; clients provide no facts.

This read-only POST recomputes the current authorized projection. It does
not create an assignment, alter an attempt or accept an evaluator result.
The worker owns its permit until synchronous work actually finishes even
if its HTTP waiter reaches the request deadline or disconnects.

Read-only engineering advice over freshly authorized owned public context.

Question-only requests retain the approved-guidance contract. Explicit
mode=conversation allows free-form unexecuted advice and bounded untrusted
page-session history. Neither mode grades, completes or consumes hint slots.

Answer from approved public passages, with exact source quotations.

No conversation persistence, account actions, source selection, arbitrary file
ingestion or learner bootstrap. A draft/expired corpus remains unavailable.
